text: Definition agreed in discussion with Juan Vaz and Fahim Ebrahimi, 2026-11-18.
The Cause of Death Register uses the international ICD-9, so 155A (liver cancer) is recorded as 155.0 (or most often 1550). ICD-9 codes in this list are therefore written in the international format.
In a sensitivity analysis, consider also using secondary causes of death with a liver-related diagnosis.
Liver-related death is also a component of MALO.
Not included: secondary liver tumours (ICD-10 C78.7), gallbladder and bile duct disease (K80-K82, K83.1-K83.9), and jaundice and hepatomegaly as symptoms (R16, R17).
Metabolic liver disease is optional (variant "optional"); the source lists no ICD-7 code for it.
ICD-10 K83.0 is described in the source as cholangitis, including sclerosing cholangitis (PSC).

Ranges are written as in the source: the three-digit ICD-8 and ICD-9 categories 570-573 and the ICD-10 range K70-K77 stand for the whole category. ICD-10 K75, K76 and K77 appear in the source after a semicolon.

The source table has two empty sub-rows ("Cirrhosis, fibrosis, biliary cirrhosis" and "Liver failure, hepatitis and other liver disease") under the alcoholic/toxic row, with no codes entered. They are not represented here.
ICD-8 571,90 is cirrhosis with portal hypertension, ICD-8 573,02 hepatic coma, ICD-8 785,30 ascites (the same ICD-8 ascites code as in the MALO list).
